metric.observed_quantity: normalized integrated mesh fission-rate fraction by fuel assembly
metric.reference_citation: Song et al., Frontiers in Energy Research (2020), Table 1, https://doi.org/10.3389/fenrg.2020.00124

uncertainty_method.observed_fraction_standard_error: sample standard error across three independent run-level fractions
uncertainty_method.reference_fraction_standard_uncertainty: first-order delta-method propagation of published raw assembly-power uncertainties through normalization
uncertainty_method.reference_covariance_assumption: raw assembly-power estimates treated as independent because no covariance matrix was available
uncertainty_method.combined_z_definition: (observed normalized fraction - reference normalized fraction) / sqrt(observed fraction SE^2 + propagated reference fraction SE^2)
uncertainty_method.acceptance_status: EXPLORATORY_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; criterion was not pre-registered as official benchmark acceptance

interpretation: All four exploratory combined-z magnitudes are below 1 under the stated independence approximation. This does not establish official benchmark acceptance, source convergence, direct power-tally equivalence, or overall physical validation. A covariance matrix and independent review of fission-rate/power comparability remain unresolved.
